criteria.how_we_satisfy_en: A dedicated research deliverable plus a per-channel rationale that states why each medium was chosen and what it uniquely does.
criteria.name: Research
criteria.quoted: Understanding of media types available and how to use them

criteria.how_we_satisfy_en: A named audience with a behavioural insight, and a USP that comes out of the niche rather than out of generic tourism.
criteria.name: Strategy
criteria.quoted: Insight on brand and target group

criteria.how_we_satisfy_en: Six executions that each do something the other five cannot, all expressing one idea.
criteria.name: Execution
criteria.quoted: Creativity of the big idea, and how it's carried across media types

criteria.how_we_satisfy_en: A structured deck with a clear reading order and a requirement-coverage checklist.
criteria.name: Presentation

note_en: Weights are inferred, not stated in the brief. They are used only to order effort, never to justify skipping a requirement.
